title: Stop judging your entire movie by the opening scene. 🎬⚔️
paragraphs: Stop judging your entire movie by the opening scene. 🎬⚔️

It’s easy to feel insignificant when you’re in the "humble beginnings" phase. You see the mud, the struggle, and the slow progress. But God sees the finale. He sees the victory, the redemption, and the legacy.
Your current situation isn’t your destination—it’s just the training ground. If the dream looks too big for where you are right now, good. That means it requires God to make it happen.
Verse: 📖 "Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would increase abundantly." — Job 8:7
